name: no-ai-slop
description: Deterministic AI-slop guard: a PreToolUse hook greps content headed to Notion, Slack, Gmail, Artifacts, prose .md files, and prose string literals in source files against a high-precision banned-phrase list, decoding HTML entities first, and blocks it for rewrite before it is ever published.
